	 * - Ensures each tab points (aria-controls) to a role="tabpanel" with matching id
	 * - Gives each panel aria-labelledby referencing its tab

	 * - Adds keyboard support: Left/Right/Home/End + Enter/Space activation
	 */
	(function()
	{
		const CONTAINER_ID = 'CashBidsLocationTabs_70';
		const ACTIVE_CLASS = 'resp-tab-active';

		function uniqueId(base)
		{
			let id = base,
				n = 1;
			while (document.getElementById(id)) id = base + '-' + (n++);
			return id;
		}

		function init(container)
		{
			if (!container || container.__tabsFixed) return;
			container.__tabsFixed = true;

			const tablist = container.querySelector('.resp-tabs-list');
			if (!tablist) return;
			tablist.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');

			const panelsWrapper = container.querySelector('.resp-tabs-container');
			const foundPanels = panelsWrapper ? Array.from(panelsWrapper.querySelectorAll('.resp-tab-content')) : [];

			const tabs = Array.from(tablist.children).filter(li =>
				li.matches('.resp-tab-item, [role="tab"]')
			);

			tabs.forEach((tab, index) =>
			{
				tab.setAttribute('role', 'tab');

				// ID
				if (!tab.id)
				{
					const base = (tab.textContent || 'tab').trim().toLowerCase()
						.replace(/\s+/g, '-')
						.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, '') || 'tab';
					tab.id = uniqueId(base);
				}

				const isActive = tab.classList.contains(ACTIVE_CLASS);
				tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', isActive ? 'true' : 'false');
				tab.setAttribute('tabindex', isActive ? '0' : '-1');

				// Panel binding
				let panelId = tab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
				let panel = panelId ? document.getElementById(panelId) : null;

				if (!panel)
				{
					// Try panel by index
					panel = foundPanels[index] || null;
					if (panel)
					{
						panelId = panel.id || uniqueId(tab.id + '-panel');
						panel.id = panelId;
						tab.setAttribute('aria-controls', panelId);
					}
					else
					{
						// Create placeholder if none exists
						panelId = uniqueId(tab.id + '-panel');

						panel.className = 'resp-tab-content';
						panelsWrapper && panelsWrapper.appendChild(panel);

					}
				}

				// Panel semantics
				if (panel)
				{
					panel.setAttribute('role', 'tabpanel');
					panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', tab.id);
					panel.hidden = !isActive;
					panel.classList.toggle('resp-tab-content-active', isActive);
				}

				// Activate on click
				tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab, tablist));

				// Keyboard support
				tab.addEventListener('keydown', (e) =>
				{
					const keys = ['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End', 'Enter', ' '];
					if (!keys.includes(e.key)) return;
					const enabled = tabs;
					let idx = enabled.indexOf(tab);

					if (e.key === 'ArrowRight')
					{
						e.preventDefault();
						idx = (idx + 1) % enabled.length;
						enabled[idx].focus();
						activateTab(enabled[idx], tablist);
					}
					else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')
					{
						e.preventDefault();
						idx = (idx - 1 + enabled.length) % enabled.length;
						enabled[idx].focus();
						activateTab(enabled[idx], tablist);
					}
					else if (e.key === 'Home')
					{
						e.preventDefault();
						enabled[0].focus();
						activateTab(enabled[0], tablist);
					}
					else if (e.key === 'End')
					{
						e.preventDefault();
						enabled[enabled.length - 1].focus();
						activateTab(enabled[enabled.length - 1], tablist);
					}
					else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')
					{
						e.preventDefault();
						activateTab(tab, tablist);
					}
				});
			});

			// Fix accordion headers misusing role="tab"
			container.querySelectorAll('.resp-accordion[role="tab"]').forEach(acc =>
			{
				acc.removeAttribute('role');
				// If no button inside, create one for toggle semantics (mobile view)
				if (!acc.querySelector('button.resp-accordion-trigger'))
				{
					const btn = document.createElement('button');
					btn.type = 'button';
					btn.className = 'resp-accordion-trigger';
					const active = acc.classList.contains(ACTIVE_CLASS);
					// Use first tab as controller in single-tab scenario
					const firstTab = tabs[0];
					btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', active ? 'true' : 'false');
					if (firstTab) btn.setAttribute('aria-controls', firstTab.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
					btn.textContent = firstTab ? firstTab.textContent.trim() : acc.textContent.trim();
					acc.textContent = '';
					acc.appendChild(btn);
					btn.addEventListener('click', () => firstTab && firstTab.click());
				}
			});
		}

		function activateTab(tab, tablist)
		{
			const tabs = tablist.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
			tabs.forEach(t =>
			{
				const active = t === tab;
				t.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
				t.setAttribute('tabindex', active ? '0' : '-1');
				t.classList.toggle(ACTIVE_CLASS, active);
				const panelId = t.getAttribute('aria-controls');
				if (panelId)
				{
					const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
					if (panel)
					{
						panel.hidden = !active;
						panel.classList.toggle('resp-tab-content-active', active);
					}
				}
			});
			// Sync accordion trigger expanded state (single header pattern)
			const trigger = document.querySelector('#' + CONTAINER_ID + ' .resp-accordion-trigger');
			if (trigger) trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
		}

		function run()
		{
			const container = document.getElementById(CONTAINER_ID);
			if (container) init(container);
		}

		if (document.readyState === 'loading')
		{
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
		}
		else
		{
			run();
		}
	})();

<script>
	/**
	 * Fix invalid ARIA on easyResponsiveTabs accordion headers.
	 * Problems:
	 *  - <h2 class="resp-accordion" role="tab" aria-controls="tab_item-X"> points to non-existent IDs (tab_item-X not in DOM)
	 *  - role="tab" used outside a parent role="tablist"
	 * Solution:
	 *  - Give each .resp-tab-content a real id (if missing)
	 *  - Map each LI.tab to its panel via aria-controls
	 *  - Convert each H2.resp-accordion into: <h2 class="resp-accordion" role="heading" aria-level="3"><button ...></button></h2>
	 *  - Button gets aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at panel id
	 *  - Remove invalid original role/aria-controls on H2
	 *  - Keep existing active classes, sync expanded state
	 */
	(function()
	{
		const TABLIST_SELECTOR = '.resp-tabs-list';
		const ACCORDION_SELECTOR = 'h2.resp-accordion';
		const PANEL_SELECTOR = '.resp-tab-content';

		function uniqueId(prefix)
		{
			let n = 0;
			let id;
			do {
				id = prefix + (++n);
			} while (document.getElementById(id));
			return id;
		}

		function initTabSet(tablist)
		{
			if (!tablist || tablist.__ariaFixed) return;
			tablist.__ariaFixed = true;

			if (tablist.getAttribute('role') !== 'tablist')
			{
				tablist.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');
			}

			const tabs = Array.from(tablist.children).filter(li => li.classList.contains('resp-tab-item'));
			// Find the sibling container
			let container = tablist.closest('#CashBidsLocationTabs_70, #horizontalFuturesTabs, .fctabs, body')
				.querySelector('.resp-tabs-container');
			if (!container) return;

			const panels = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(':scope > ' + PANEL_SELECTOR));
			const accs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(':scope > ' + ACCORDION_SELECTOR));

			const count = Math.min(tabs.length, panels.length);

			for (let i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				const tab = tabs[i];
				const panel = panels[i];
				const accH2 = accs[i];

				// Ensure panel has id
				if (!panel.id)
				{
					panel.id = uniqueId('resp-panel-');
				}

				// Prepare tab (LI acts as tab)
				tab.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
				if (!tab.id) tab.id = uniqueId('resp-tab-');
				const active = tab.classList.contains('resp-tab-active');
				tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
				tab.setAttribute('tabindex', active ? '0' : '-1');
				tab.setAttribute('aria-controls', panel.id);

				// Prepare panel

				panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', tab.id);
				panel.hidden = !active;

					if (!btn)

						// Collect text (fallback to textContent)
						const label = accH2.textContent.trim();
						accH2.innerHTML = '';
						btn = document.createElement('button');
						btn.type = 'button';
						btn.className = 'resp-accordion-trigger';
						btn.textContent = label;
						accH2.appendChild(btn);
					}

					btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', active ? 'true' : 'false');

					if (!btn._bound)

					}
				}

				if (!tab._bound)
				{
					tab.addEventListener('click', () => activate(tablist, tab));
					tab.addEventListener('keydown', e =>
					{
						const keys = ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End', 'Enter', ' '];
						if (!keys.includes(e.key)) return;
						const order = tabs.filter(t => t.getAttribute('role') === 'tab');
						let idx = order.indexOf(tab);
						if (e.key === 'ArrowRight')
						{
							idx = (idx + 1) % order.length;
							e.preventDefault();
							order[idx].focus();
							activate(tablist, order[idx]);
						}
						else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')
						{
							idx = (idx - 1 + order.length) % order.length;

							order[idx].focus();

						}
						else if (e.key === 'Home')
						{

						}

						}
						else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')
						{
							e.preventDefault();
							activate(tablist, tab);
						}
					});
					tab._bound = true;
				}
			}
		}

		function activate(tablist, targetTab)
		{
			const tabs = Array.from(tablist.children).filter(li => li.classList.contains('resp-tab-item') && li.getAttribute('role') === 'tab');
			tabs.forEach(tab =>
			{
				const active = tab === targetTab;
				tab.classList.toggle('resp-tab-active', active);
				tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
				tab.setAttribute('tabindex', active ? '0' : '-1');
				const pid = tab.getAttribute('aria-controls');
				const panel = pid && document.getElementById(pid);
				if (panel)
				{
					panel.hidden = !active;
					panel.classList.toggle('resp-tab-content-active', active);
				}
			});

			// Sync accordion buttons
			const container = tablist.closest('#CashBidsLocationTabs_70, #horizontalFuturesTabs, .fctabs, body')
				.querySelector('.resp-tabs-container');
			if (container)
			{
				container.querySelectorAll('h2.resp-accordion button.resp-accordion-trigger').forEach(btn =>
				{
					btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',
						btn.getAttribute('aria-controls') === targetTab.getAttribute('aria-controls') ? 'true' : 'false');
				});
			}
		}

		function fixAll()
		{
			document.querySelectorAll(TABLIST_SELECTOR).forEach(initTabSet);
			// Remove any leftover bad aria-controls on h2 that point to non-existent nodes
			document.querySelectorAll(ACCORDION_SELECTOR).forEach(h2 =>
			{
				const c = h2.getAttribute('aria-controls');
				if (c && !document.getElementById(c)) h2.removeAttribute('aria-controls');
			});
		}

		if (document.readyState === 'loading')
		{
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fixAll);
		}
		else
		{
			fixAll();
		}

		// Expose manual hook
		window.fixAccordionAria = fixAll;
	})();
